However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PM SHRI KV NO-03, BHUBANESWAR ATC: FACILITY MANAGEMENT SERVICES 1. All types of material, labour charges and other accessories required for repair & maintenance will be pro vided by the service provider himself i.e the rate should be inclusive of all these things. Minor repair of fu rniture (as per requirement) is part of the bid therefore the bidders are advised to inspect the site thems elves before fixing the rate of work. No change in rate will be accepted at later stages. 2. The bidder has to replace and reset the furniture and other items in the rooms/corridors/place of repairing. 3. Cleanliness of the rooms/area after work would be the responsibility of bidder. The minimum lead for disposal of the debris (If any) would be 100 mtrs. 4. The bidder must arrange his own supervisor to look after the work. 5. The undersigned does not bind himself to accept the lowest quotation and reserves the right to accept the quotation in whole or in part i.e., with respect to all the work mentioned in the attach ed statement or in respect of any one or more than one work specified in the attached stateme nt. Accordingly, the undersigned reserves the right to reject any or all tenders without assigning any reasons thereof, either in full or in part. 6. The firm has never been blacklisted by any government or private entity. For this, a notarized a ffidavit signed by the authorized person of the firm on a stamp paper of Rs.100 shall be submitt ed. Old affidavit made before the commencement of bid will not be accepted. 7. The quantity of work indicated in the attached statement may be increased or decreased at the discretion of the undersigned without assigning any reason. 8. As this work is of intermittent nature which requires effective coordination, on-site supervision, and quick response for post-completion maintenance during warranty/guaranty period etc. Ther efore, the Bidder/firm must have geographical presence in the state of Odisha (An office of the S ervice Provider must be located in the state of Odisha) and shall upload a copy of Shop & Establ ishment Certificate issued by competent authority (Inspector of Shop & Commercial Establishm ent) of Govt. of Odisha in Form-3 as per Orissa Shops and Commercial Establishment Act, 1956 and its Rules, 1958 or the latest amendment(s), if any or similar documentary evidence(Address Proof of the firm) issued by competent Govt Authority of Odisha/Central Govt which establish th at the firm is having valid Geographical Presence in the state. 9. Before commencing the work, the selected bidder will have to submit the written details of the deputed workers like labourers, painters, masons and supervisors etc. at the site. Minor children and sick adults cannot be employed. 10. Smoking, drinking is strictly prohibited in the school premises. 11. If there is any kind of damage caused to the school property by the people of the contractor du ring the course of work, then the contractor will have to compensate for the same as well as the contractor will have to ensure the safety of his belongings/equipment himself. 12. The school will not be liable for any injury, death, any other damages, etc., caused by any a ccident that occurs in the course of work or for any other reason. 13. Financial Standing: The bidder should have average annual turnover of Rs.2 Lakhs (as per G eM mandated percentage of estimated bid value) or more in last preceding three financial years i.e. FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26 as per audited Balance sheet and Profit & Loss Acco unt, duly authenticated by a Chartered Accountant/Cost Accountant. The copies of Audited Annu al Accounts/CA Certificate with UDI Number for last 03 years shall be uploaded along with the bid. Registered MSME/Startup firms will be given exemption from this condition subject to submission of appropriate documents. 14. Experience and Past Performance: The bidder should have executed the following similar nature projects (Furniture) during last preceding 03 years i.e. 2022-23 to 2024-25.

One project of similar nature costing not less than the amount equal to 80% of estimated bid va lue, Or Two projects of similar nature costing not less than the amount equal to 50% of estimate d bid value, Or Three projects of similar nature costing not less than the amount equal to 40% of estimated bid value Supporting Document: Copy of work orders/Contract/Completion Certificate/other documents sho uld be submitted in this regard. Registered MSME/Startup firms will be given exemption from this condition subject to submission of appropriate documents. 15. The Net Worth of the Bidder should be positive as on 31.3.2026. A certificate in this regard fr om a practicing Chartered Accountant shall be uploaded by the Bidder with UDIN. 16. Income Tax /GST will be deducted as per Income Tax Act & Rules. Bidder must have valid GS T registration and a signed copy of the same should be uploaded. 17. Successful bidder will have to start the work within 05 days of the issue of work order and sh all complete the work within 20 days from date of issue of service order. In case of natural calami ties, challenges etc., the purchaser i.e. the Principal reserves the right to change the completion p eriod of the work at his discretion. 18. The purchaser will award the contract to the bidder whose rate has been determined to be su bstantially responsive and the bidder is otherwise eligible. 19. Determination of the lowest rate will not be on the basis of rates quoted for individual works but on the basis of aggregate amount payable on all estimated works in a particular lot of work. 20. Normal commercial guarantee shall be applicable on work and Performance Security at presc ribed rate will be deducted from the actual cost and will be return back to the successful bidder a fter guarantee period. 21. The bidder shall use good quality items. Use of any harmful chemical/paints may leads to he alth hazards to the students. To ensure the quality of the items to be used the bidder has to prese nt it before the school level committee and a declaration of this effect shall be submitted. 22. Scope of Work: Wall Painting, Roof Coating, and Window Repair SCOPE OF WORK: FACILITY MANAGEMENT 1. Scope of Work: Wall Painting, Roof Coating, and Window Repair A. Exterior and Interior Wall Painting Surface Preparation: Scraping, cleaning, rust-removal, and sanding are mandatory before painting. All materials must be ISI-marked. Finishing with premium quality emulsion/synthetic enamel paint ,d ust proof water proof with 5- year warranty (two coats) of approved colour and exterior wall surface s, and for interior premium emulsion stain repellence, antifungal 6-year warranty( two coats). Includi ng one coat of suitable primer (water proof), after thorough cleaning, de-dusting, Scraping, putty ap plying whenever required and surface preparation, complete as per direction of the Vidyalaya Com mittee. B. Epoxy Coating of Roof Thorough cleaning and preparation of the roof surface to ensure it is free from dust, debris, and moi sture. Application of high-grade, ISI-marked epoxy coating to the roof to prevent any kind of crack o r seepage. The coating must provide a durable, water-resistant seal to prevent future water logging and structural damage. C. Repairing of Window Panes and Glass Installation Inspection of all window structures and frames. Minor repairing such as fixing of nuts and bolts, hing es, polishing, welding, etc., needs to be attended wherever required. Installation of new glass panes where existing glass is broken, missing, or severely damaged. The installed glass must be securely f

itted and sealed. 2. General Conditions and Execution • All used (empty) paint, epoxy, and material containers shall be deposited in the school with the Work Monitoring Committee immediately after use. These containers will be returned to the successful bidder after completion of the e ntire work and verification by the Committee. • The successful bidder has to regularly wash and clean the floors after his wo rk in the area where work is to be done. The successful bidder's job will also i nclude removing all malba and debris arising in the process of painting, coati ng, and repairing, including washing of floor to remove stains of paint on a da y-to-day basis at no extra cost. • If it is observed that the work is being carried out without adequate safety pr ecautions, the school authorities reserve the right to stop the work immediat ely. No further coat of paint or epoxy shall be applied, till the previous coat h as completely dried. • The time allowed for completion of total painting, coating, and repair work s hall be 30 days to be reckoned from the date of issue of contract. Only traine d and experienced workers/painters must be deployed. 3. Quality Assurance, Inspection & Warranty • Work will be inspected by the PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya No. 3 Maintenanc e Committee / Principal. • Any defects noticed during execution must be rectified immediately without extra cost. • Bidder must provide a minimum 18 MONTHS warranty for peeling, fading, seepage, or premature failure of paint and roof coating. However, defects ar ising out of scratching, intentional damage, or severe structural shifts will n ot be covered under such warranty. Any defect covered under warranty mu st be rectified by the vendor during the warranty period at no cost. • The selected bidder shall carry out maintenance, repair, and painting work at the PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya No. 3 campus. Bidder must inspect the si te before quoting rates (mandatory). Manufacturers and service providers ar e advised to visit the site and thoroughly understand the nature and scope of the works and be familiar with the site conditions. 23. Notwithstanding the above, the purchaser reserves the right to accept or reject any quotati ons and to cancel the bidding process and reject all quotations at any time prior to the contract. 24. Bidders are requested to upload only the requisite documents under the prescribed heading s e.g. uploading experience certificate under MSME heading and vice-versa is of no use. Also upl oading a common bunch of documents (many are of no use and misleading too) in all headings will not be entertained. In such cases we will consider the document at first page against the de sired heading. In-accordance with the ATC following documents/certificates are to be uploaded:

Sl. Name of document/Certificate No 01. Notarized affidavit on a Rs.100/- non-judicial stamp paper that the firm has never been bla cklisted by any Govt. or Private Entity. 02. Valid certificate of Geographical Presence in the state of Odisha. 03. Copies of Audited Annual Accounts/CA Certificate with UDI Number for last 03 years (FY 2 023-24, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26) for proving financial standing. 04. Document establishing EXPERIENCE & PAST PERFORMANCE. 05. Certificate from a practicing CA (with UDIN) that the Net Worth of the Bidder was Positive as on 31.3.2026. 06. Copy of GST registration. 07. Signed copy of Bid document. 08. In addition to the aforementioned documents, the documents required in bidding docume nts also to be uploaded. 25. UNRESPONSIVE TENDERS: The following kind of bidders will be treated as unresponsive: I. Not meeting the qualifying criteria. II. Not uploading the documents required in ATC and bid document. III. The specification of the paper (e.g. registered contractor certificate, labour license etc) upl oaded not found of the quality asked for or uploading misleading documents. IV. The bidder not agreeing to any of the terms & conditions so listed. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
